term.gujarati: વિદ્યુત પ્રવાહની ચુંબકીય અસર (Vidyut Pravahni Chumbakiya Asar)
term.hindi: विद्युत धारा का चुंबकीय प्रभाव (Vidyut Dhara ka Chumbakiya Prabhav)

definition.simple: When electricity flows through a wire, it acts like a magnet.
definition.academic: The phenomenon where an electric current flowing through a conductor produces a magnetic field around it.

examples: Deflection of a compass needle near a current-carrying wire

common_misconceptions: Students often think magnetism and electricity are completely separate things.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind the student of Oersted's accidental experiment with the compass.
